title: Chapter 195: The Zerg Are Going To Fight Back
content:
Chapter 195: The Zerg Are Going To Fight Back

"If this is the case, Gong Zhe, you must fully support the development of the Zerg here, so that the Zerg can break out of this small world as soon as possible and enter a larger battlefield!"

"The more Zerg energy coins our tribe needs, the better!"

"As for the cooperation between the two tribes, I will arrange someone to contact you after I go back. We will first discuss the technology. If there is value in cooperation, we will conduct in-depth cooperative research!"

"I brought the personnel and materials needed to build the branch this time, as well as the goods you applied for the Zerg, Gong Zhe, I brought them all!"

"There are enough things here for you to be busy for a while!"

"The rest of the things will be left to you two to deal with. You give me all the Zerg energy coins you prepared this time. I'm waiting to go back!"

Gong Rui arranged things in a clear and orderly manner and was about to go back with the Zerg energy coins.

Gong Zhe had a batch of Zerg energy coins in his hand. He only sent a few samples back to the tribe, and most of the Zerg energy coins were still in his hands.

Wu Qing knew that there were big figures coming to the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, so he also prepared a batch of Zerg energy coins in advance.

The total amount of Zerg Energy Coins in the hands of the two people is enough to make Gong Rui feel that his trip was worthwhile.

"Very good! You can slowly settle the settlement later! I'm leaving!"

Gong Rui saw the Zerg Energy Coins prepared by the two people, and left without saying a word!

As for contracts, agreements, etc., they are not needed. This is a world that speaks with strength. No matter how clear the black and white words are, without the guarantee of strength, it is just a useless piece of white paper.

Gong Rui, the elder of the goblin tribe, came and left in a hurry. He took the Zerg Energy Coins and sat in his special goblin transport vehicle and disappeared in an instant.

The time he spent with Wu Qing and Gong Zhe did not exceed ten minutes in total.

"Lord Wu Qing, please don't mind. Many of the elders of our tribe who have been in the research room for many years have this style of doing things. They are not specifically targeting us!"

As soon as the goblin elders left, Gong Zhe immediately explained to Wu Qing.

"I like this efficient style of doing things!"

Wu Qing smiled.

The goblin transport vehicles of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce are still coming and parking in an orderly manner around the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

It is still early now, and this is within the protection range of the Lord of Mengzhong City, so construction can start at night. The construction team of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce who came over got off the car and started working.

These people have been sitting in the car and don’t need to rest at all.

The unloading, handling, field mapping, and command and dispatch did not need Gong Zhe’s participation, and they worked in an orderly manner, with very high efficiency.

Gong Zhe asked Wu Qing to wait for a moment, and he went to find the person in charge of the caravan and brought the list of goods this time.

"Lord Wu Qing, this is the list of goods sent by the Chamber of Commerce this time. The types and quantities are much more than what I applied for. Please take a look!"

Gong Zhe was very happy to see the list of goods. The things transported this time were more than what he applied for, which showed that the tribe valued the Zerg and him.

Wu Qing took a large list of goods and flipped through it briefly. Most of them were things he had mentioned when chatting with Gong Zhe before, and there were even some related and similar things. This proved that the Goblin Chamber of Commerce treated his requirements with heart.

First of all, there are books. Wu Qing wants all kinds of books. As long as it is knowledge, it will be valuable.

Then there is population. Wu Qing picked out the same tribes of the major lords of the alliance, such as the tiger tribe, fox tribe, stone tribe, feather tribe and wolf tribe, and left these people to Meng and them.

Because Wu Qing specifically mentioned these races to Gong Zhe, the population of these major races in the population transported this time is calculated in tens of thousands, and there are also many people of the main races in other small territories.

It is not an easy task to take these people. Wu Qing plans to buy them first and then transfer them to the major lords of the alliance, so that they can pay back slowly in the future.

Wu Qing thinks that the various territories of the alliance should focus on the development of the main race. It would be great if each territory can pull out an elite army of the main race.

Of course, territories with strong comprehensive strength, such as Meng's Menghu Territory and Hu Wei's Hujiaqiu Territory, can form several more strong armies.

The alliance is only a prototype now. In Wu Qing's vision, the alliance is a platform for absorbing the small and medium-sized races and territories in this world to join in the future. It is directly asking these races and territories to submit to the Zerg. Not to mention whether they are willing or not, other big races will not agree.

With the alliance as a platform, these races or territories will feel more comfortable when they choose to join, and it is not easy for the outside world to interfere, because the alliance is still a joint and mutual assistance organization in name, not a subordinate organization of anyone.

Therefore, Wu Qing will always support the development of this alliance, but will not control it in name.

In addition to the main population of these alliance territories, Wu Qing wants all the other populations. The construction progress of Daxia Territory is very fast, and now there is Guangfu City. With the counterattack of the Zerg, there will be more cities occupied in the future. This population is nothing at all.

When the branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce is established, Wu Qing will also ask for more refugees to exchange for Zerg energy coins.

With people, there will be luck, cause and effect, and emotions, which are all qi resources for the system.

Of course, the more people, the better!

It is worth noting that among these people, there are more than 50,000 human beings. This is Wu Qing's special request. Wu Qing himself is a human being, and he has some ideas about the human beings in this world, so the number of real human beings under his command cannot be small.

According to Gong Zhe, there are very few human beings in this area, and it is not the main activity area of human beings. It must have taken some thought to get so many human refugees this time.

For other commodities, Wu Qing selected some that he was interested in and needed by Daxia Territory, as well as various weapons and equipment urgently needed by various territories of the alliance. The rest will be placed here with Gong Zhe first, so that the lords of the alliance can come and buy them slowly.

As for the settlement, because both parties have a good willingness to cooperate and have the strong support of the goblins, Gong Zhe gave the Zerg energy coins a redemption price that Wu Qing was very satisfied with, and both parties were happy.

Wu Qing chatted with Gong Zhe for a while and left. He only took away the books, and other goods would be sent to other people to receive.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce's branch in Mengzhong City has begun a major construction. The surrounding spies were blocked outside the territory by the Zerg dogs. They didn't know what the huge Goblin Chamber of Commerce caravan was doing, and they kept wandering around.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone returned to Mengzhong City and asked the host to enter all the books he brought back into the Queen's information database.

He glanced at these books. The content of these books was more valuable than the last books. It seemed that Gong Zhe had applied for it specifically.

But in general, the books circulating in this world rarely record important information. For example, the map of the surrounding areas that Wu Qing is most concerned about now does not have any detailed records.

"Some things may require reaching a certain level to access!"

Wu Qing also understood that this world is generally conservative. Listening to the tone of the goblin elder, the area where the Zerg is located is nothing in this world.

In addition to the Zerg energy coins, the goblins also look down on the Zerg's strength.

If you want to know more, you still have to work hard to develop and go out as soon as possible.

…

Wu Qing notified the lords of Daxia Territory and the Alliance to come to Mengzhong City to receive personnel and materials. The sooner these things are used, the more valuable they are. Wu Qing paid for the things that Daxia Territory and the Alliance territories urgently needed.

The branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has not been established yet, and it is not convenient to leave so many goods with Gong Zhe.

Hu Tu received Wu Qing's notice and immediately dispatched personnel, prepared transportation tools, formed a transportation team, and went to Mengzhong City. Everything was in good shape and extremely efficient.

After this period of practical training, Hu Tu, a young fox boy, has initially acquired the qualities of a manager.

Meng and Hu Wei and other alliance lords received Wu Qing's news and were even more delighted. Wu Qing had told them that they could take the things shipped by the Goblin Chamber of Commerce first, and then pay Wu Qing for the goods when they had savings.

Such a good thing has given the alliance territories, which have already emptied their funds, another opportunity for rapid development. They have finally understood that Wu Qing and the Zerg are disdaining their weak strength and are vigorously supporting their development. If they don't work hard, they will really be left behind.

Meng led the lords of the alliance, put down their work, and hurriedly led people from Guangfu City to Mengzhong City. Now they can still receive personnel and materials. After spending a night in Mengzhong City, they can be transported back to their respective territories tomorrow.

When Meng, Hu Wei, Shi Gan, Yu Chong and Bai Yan saw tens of thousands of refugees from their own tribes, they were all excited, especially Meng, Shi Gan and Yu Chong. The refugees from the Tiger Tribe, the Stone Tribe and the Feather Tribe are very rare. The refugees from their three tribes are very strong and are in great demand. In the area where the alliance is located, it is very lucky to see them in the caravan.

Now tens of thousands of refugees from the same tribe have been transported at once, and the three of them are a little bit unbelievable.

Hu Wei and Bai Yan were slightly better. Their fellow refugees were not uncommon, but the number of refugees transported this time was large and of good quality. They also knew that this was the result of Wu Qing's sincere help.

For other alliance lords, although their fellow refugees were not as many as those of the five major territories, they were also a considerable number, enough for their territories to digest for a long time.

Wu Qing treated the territories of the alliance differently according to their strength. Everyone could understand that the bigger the appetite, the more food they eat. If Wu Qing treated them equally and gave too much, those small territories might not be able to pay them back in their lifetime.

The originally empty Mengzhong City became lively again. A large number of people moved in and exchanged personnel and materials with the Goblin Chamber of Commerce overnight. The various territories of the alliance needed these high-quality personnel and sophisticated equipment, and they did not want to delay for a moment.
